title: Spotlight: Hot Target Discovery and Localization with Crowdsourced Photos
motivation: Crowd photos capture attention but现有定位方法需要prior deployment或intentional photographing，无法passive localization
problem_framing: Define hot targets: objects with overlapping FOVs in crowdsourced photos; localize using camera GPS+azimuth rays
key_insight: Objects drawing attention produce overlapping FOVs; localization by ray intersection from multi-view photos on ground plane
method_signature: K-partite graph + maximum weight clique + plane geometry ray intersection localization
evaluation_criteria: Localization error (meters) vs number of overlapping valid photos (5/10/15)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: incorrectly combined object image produces significant error; incomplete combination less harmful than false combination
evidence_for_taste: Incompletely combined ones are better than incorrectly combined ones
a small error in the azimuth is likely to lead to a very poor localization result
an incorrectly combined object image produces a significant error in localization
the absence of a single object image will make little difference
thinking_moves: 把perception问题reframe成DFPL device-free passive localization问题
利用crowdsourcing天然冗余性抑制个体测量误差
宁可false negative不要false positive以保护后续定位精度
把object combination问题建模为图论的最大加权团问题
强调strict combining strategy而非aggressive path search
extraction_notes: Yunhao Liu appears as last author (Changjiang professor, dean of School of Software at Tsinghua), indicating senior role. Venue not explicitly stated in paper text.
